validate_attachment_sizes: validate file attachment sizes by checking individual and total base64 encoded file data against maximum limits
read_text_file_contents: read text file contents from a sandbox filesystem and return decoded UTF-8 text up to a maximum size
extract_pdf_text: extract text from a PDF file in the sandbox filesystem page by page up to a maximum character limit
encode_image_to_base64: read an image file from the sandbox filesystem and return its contents as a base64 encoded string
review_utils_functions: review the utility functions for file attachment validation and sandbox filesystem file content reading
